# hereplatform_app (Data Source)

Looks up a HERE platform app by HRN or by exact name.

Lookups by name list the apps visible to the provider's identity: HERE filters `GET /apps` by the caller's permissions, so apps the identity cannot read, write, manage or share are not found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hereplatform_app" "by_hrn" {
  hrn = "hrn:here:account::myrealm:app/AbCdEfGhIjKlMnOpQrSt"
}

# Name lookups only see the apps the provider's identity has permissions on.
data "hereplatform_app" "by_name" {
  name = "example-service"
}

output "example_client_id" {
  value = data.hereplatform_app.by_name.client_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `hrn` (String) HRN of the app to look up. Exactly one of `hrn` or `name` is required.
- `name` (String) Exact name of the app to look up. The lookup fails unless exactly one visible app has this name.

### Read-Only

- `app_creation_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the app may create other apps.
- `client_id` (String) OAuth client ID of the app.
- `created_time` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `id` (String) HRN of the app.
- `realm` (String) Realm (organization ID) the app belongs to.
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status reported by HERE.
